vector.scope: Bounded workbench runtime/protocol integration; no search, agent, Runner state or acceptance

completion.scope: Named CTA/kernel completion from logs; numerical and trace checks remain separate.

functional_reference.scope: Finite outputs and named completion for this frozen program/input/launch on the recorded RTL.

execution.completion_scope: control/address execution and modeled timing dispatches

program.stack_policy: warp-private scalar spill stack; work-group LDS allocation
program.register_policy: compiler usage rounded to complete RF-bank rows at launch
program.collective_policy: uniform full-workgroup PC/flags; per-warp memory snapshots published at matching local/global fences; conservative block timing fences

resource_admission.scope: Static capacity upper bound; excludes allocator timing/fragmentation and achieved occupancy.

limitations: Finite numerical correctness is rechecked from recorded RTL logs; RTL is not rerun by this evaluator.
Cycles come from the native timing model; they are not measured RTL cycles or an accuracy claim.
Boot/CTA/cold instruction fetch and RTL output flush are not matched timing endpoints.
Registered cases and baseline hardware only; uniform workgroup barriers use conservative model fences; subgroup/atomic synchronization remains unsupported.
Registered GEMM realization bindings are rechecked when present; this evaluator does not run a solver, compiler or RTL itself.
Private spill layout requires an explicit matching workgroup-private-v1 driver reference; historical upstream-driver runs need separate treatment.
